verdict.rationale: Missive documents AI composing and replying inside the app, and says assistant-created drafts land as drafts that resolve the user's name and email from their profile. That covers the 'draft ready to review and send' part. Nothing in the pack shows the AI learning or matching the user's personal voice or tone, so the story's central element is unevidenced. missing for 10: voice/tone personalization or style learning from past emails, controls for tone, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality versus generic output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.

Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile, exactly like the composer does.
Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies without leaving the chat
